decision.observation: Camera has risen above the slab: the hazy mountain with its pale blue vertical streak is now visible at upper center-left, with pale slab blocks and an orange-red rock bench to the right, red-sand ground below. Pink mitten hand rests at the slab's right edge; stamina full green with hatched tail.
decision.hypothesis: The blue-streak mountain is the objective and it lies beyond the open red sand to the right of these slabs. The climb may have lifted me slightly, but the walkable route is the open sand toward the pale blocks.
decision.memory: Blue-streak summit mountain re-sighted from above the pool slabs; open red sand and pale blocks lie to its right.
